DiPlay is the direct upstream of L7 CarPlay, providing the CarPlay protocol, connection, authentication and media receiver core. L7 CarPlay maintains Galaxy L7 adaptations on the original 0.2.11 baseline.

Geely fork · Audio profile and hotspot settings

Thanks to carlito12345 for sharing the open-source DiPlay fork for Geely head units. L7 CarPlay refers to its Bluetooth media handoff, steering-wheel input and audio compatibility implementations, evaluating each adaptation against actual Galaxy L7 capabilities.

Audio configuration, focus handling and hotspot settings are adapted from its v0.2.11 release. This does not mean all features are integrated or the new L7 build is vehicle-verified.
